summary: Add isolated SDK read, PTY and mutation subpaths while retaining the complete effect entry

schema.detail: No database or wire schema changes.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rules or digest changes.

compatibility.detail: Existing @fractal/sdk/effect and /admission callers remain supported. The additive /read entry exposes collection, roster, conversation and terminal-screen reads plus decoding, freshness and tracing helpers; /pty exposes PTY services; /mutations exposes HTTP snapshot, message sending and arrangement actions. The read service uses @fractal/sdk/Read, not the compatibility entry's @fractal/sdk/Fractal tag; callers must pair each entry's service with its own layer. Read still imports the shared generated client, including its mutation methods and schemas, but not SDK mutation or PTY services. Web callers migrate separately.

manual.detail: No required configuration or state migration.
